howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Worldwise is a short daily geography ritual about relationships between places—not a memory quiz.
howToPlay.dailyBody: Every UTC day has one shared challenge in each mode. Complete the three required medium challenges to finish the ritual and advance your streak.
howToPlay.requiredTier: Medium is the required tier and is designed to take a few minutes.
howToPlay.bonusTiers: Easy and Hard are optional bonus challenges. They never affect your streak.
howToPlay.compassBody: Read the origin country and its neighbors, then point the arrow toward the destination. After submitting, compare your arrow with the perfect bearing.
howToPlay.arrangeBody: Put places in the correct geographic order. Use the up and down controls—dragging is never required.
howToPlay.borderRunBody: Build a route from the origin to the destination using only countries that share a land border.
howToPlay.scoringBody: Scores are based on correctness. Some modes award partial credit when your answer is close. Time is recorded for your own context, but never changes your score.
howToPlay.practiceBody: Choose World or Europe, a mode, and a difficulty for unlimited fresh challenges. Practice progress is separate from your daily streak.
howToPlay.privacyTitle: Your progress stays on this device
howToPlay.privacyBody: Worldwise has no account or leaderboard. Daily progress, streaks, and statistics are stored locally in your browser.
